Sky Glass TV requires new or existing Sky TV Streaming subscription (from £15 a month for new streaming TV customers with 24-month minimum term. Prices may change during 24-month minimum) Further terms apply. Please see sky.com/tv.

Ultra HD and Dolby Atmos Pack (£6pm extra. 31-day rolling subscription) required to watch Sky content in UHD/HDR and with Dolby Atmos. 31 days’ notice to cancel. Dolby Digital Plus must be enabled in Settings to experience Dolby Atmos sound. Not all content available in UHD and/or HDR. Requires broadband min speed 30Mb/s. Offers end 11/02/26.
